risks.risk: Transmission may not match the claimed M278/G63 application, or label number doesn't correspond to that part.
risks.proof: Clear, in-focus photo of the full ID tag/label with all digits and barcode legible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unidentified automatic transmission, not the specific premium model claimed

risks.risk: Internal wear (clutches, bands, solenoids, torque converter) could be damaged despite external appearance.
risks.proof: Video of unit running on a test bench, or borescope/teardown photos of internals.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/as-is, worst case needing rebuild

risks.risk: Unit may have been opened/repaired previously, affecting value and risk of hidden issues.
risks.proof: Close-up of casing bolts/seals for tool marks or broken factory seals.

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or internal fluid condition (burnt, metal shavings) not visible in current photos.
risks.proof: Photo/video of fluid draining from the pan, showing color and any debris.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown fluid condition, worst case contaminated

risks.risk: Electrical/wiring harness and connector compatibility with buyer's vehicle unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up of connector pinout/plug type matched against target vehicle's harness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as compatibility-unconfirmed, risk of needing adapter or non-fit

risks.risk: Claimed Belgian Tokunbo origin and import paperwork cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of bill of lading, customs clearance, or shipping invoice showing origin.
risks.if_unproven: priced as origin-unverified, no premium for import provenance

proof_requests: Clear, legible close-up of the full ID/label tag on the transmission casing including all digits and barcode
Video of the unit running on a test bench with audible operation (no knock/slip)
Close-up photos of casing bolts and seals showing no prior disassembly
Photo/video of transmission fluid being drained, showing color and clarity
Photo of import/customs documentation if claiming Tokunbo/Belgium origin
Close-up of wiring harness connector type for compatibility check
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is an automatic transmission assembly with torque converter, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified model, untested, unknown internal condition) pending the listed proofs to raise value.
